guidance: Starting funds are generated once. Four D6 are rolled without attribute house options.

Saleable goods are recorded as a value; they are not added to credits or converted to equipment.

Grant the fixed personal gear once. It costs no credits and has no reviewed weight or combat effects.

RMK, called Stitcher in the class list and Knitter in the equipment list: six reusable robots clean and suture external cuts with 90% suturing ability. They do not treat internal injuries, broken bones or severe wounds. This device capability does not change the character's Paramedic skill. Purchase price: 24000 credits. Ultimate Edition p.263 / PDF266.

PDD plays and records audio on one- and three-inch discs. Blank discs cost 10–20 credits for two or three hours; prerecorded discs cost 20–80 credits. PDD purchase price: 1200–2400 credits. Media selection remains pending. Ultimate Edition p.263 / PDF266.
The grappling hook does not grant its separate weapon proficiency. Hook attacks and its proficiency-dependent Climbing bonus remain pending.

knife-weapon.name: Weapon for automatic W.P. Knife

source.section: Wilderness Scout Standard Equipment and Money

guidance: Choose one weapon matching this actual weapon proficiency. These grants are separate from the survival knife, hand axe and Vibro-Blade.

The source grants 1D4 E-Clips for each weapon proficiency; each recorded weapon grant includes that many standard spare E-Clips, including when a melee weapon is chosen. Spare clips do not make a melee weapon ranged.
Weapon choices use the reviewed representative catalog; additional weapon types remain pending.
